name: read-file-range-raw
description: Read a 20-line text file whole, with a line range (verifying selector slicing), with :raw, and tail :-2.

name: read-selectors
description: Exercise every read selector form, multi-ranges, out-of-bounds, reversed, and invalid selectors.

name: read-truncation
description: Exercise line truncation, wide-line truncation, raw wide line, and empty file.
setup: seq 1 5000 | sed 's/^/row /' > long.txt && printf 'x%.0s' $(seq 1 3000) > wide.txt && printf '\nshort\n' >> wide.txt && : > empty.txt

name: read-directory-missing-binary
description: Read a directory with deterministic mtimes, a missing file, and a POSIX-octal binary file.
setup: mkdir -p sub && printf 'a\n' > sub/alpha.txt && printf 'bb\n' > sub/beta.txt && touch -t 202001010001 sub/alpha.txt && touch -t 202001010002 sub/beta.txt && touch -t 202001010003 sub && printf '\000\001\002\003\004\005\377\376\000\000hello\000bin' > blob.bin

name: read-directory-many
description: Read a directory with >12 children, pagination selector, and nested subdirectory.
setup: mkdir -p d/sub && i=0 && for n in $(seq -w 1 30); do i=$((i+1)); printf x > d/f$n.txt; touch -t 2020010100$(printf %02d $i) d/f$n.txt; done && i=0 && for n in $(seq -w 1 15); do i=$((i+1)); printf yy > d/sub/g$n.txt; touch -t 2019010100$(printf %02d $i) d/sub/g$n.txt; done && touch -t 201801010000 d/sub d

name: read-structured
description: Read JSON with jq query, TAR archive listing/member/missing, and Jupyter notebook projection.

name: read-image-vision
description: Read a real 1x1 PNG image with a vision-capable model (captures attached image user message).

name: read-local-http-url
description: Read plain text, >2KB HTML (exercising native HTML->Markdown converter), and raw HTML from the loopback fixture HTTP server.
